description: This file defines a custom exception class `SecurityHubException` for the AWS SecurityHub SDK, extending from the general AWS exception class `AwsException`. It is part of the `Aws\SecurityHub\Exception` namespace and is used to represent errors specific to interactions with the AWS SecurityHub service.

classes.name: SecurityHubException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing errors related to AWS SecurityHub service interactions, extending from `AwsException`.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherited from `AwsException`, used for initialization of exception instances.
